title: TheMA - Open Access Research Journal for Theatre, Music, Arts. Southeast European Music, Theatre, Arts, Culture, Vol. VIII/1-2
summary: TheMA is a peer-reviewed open-access research journal dedicated to the history of performing and visual arts. It is published biannually and specializes in the critical and trans-disciplinary historical study of artistic production and reception in various artistic genres including literature, theatre, music, painting, sculpture, and architecture.
